IN DER BESCHREIBUNG AUFGEFÜHRTE DOKUMENTE
Diese Liste der vom Anmelder aufgeführten Dokumente wurde ausschließlich zur Information des Lesers aufgenommen und ist nicht Bestandteil des europäischen Patentdokumentes. Sie wurde mit größter Sorgfalt zusammengestellt; das EPA übernimmt jedoch keinerlei Haftung für etwaige Fehler oder Auslassungen.
paragraphs.en:
DOCUMENTS CITED IN THE DESCRIPTION
This list of documents cited by the applicant has been included solely for the information of the reader and is not part of the European patent document. It was compiled with the greatest care; the EPO nevertheless accepts no liability whatsoever for any errors or omissions.
paragraphs.notes: MARKER NOTE: this page carries no [00NN] paragraph markers. The printed section heading is used as the marker. WHAT THIS PAGE IS: this is the EPO's cited-documents appendix, machine-generated apparatus appended by the European Patent Office, NOT the applicant's disclosure. The disclaimer printed here says so in the document's own words: the list is for the reader's information and is not part of the European patent document. A later pass must not treat any document listed on this page as content of the invention, as prior art asserted by the applicant in the drafting sense, or as a source of chemistry. The heading is set in bold small caps on the page and the disclaimer paragraph is set in italic; that is typographic and is not marked up in the zh text. The page is otherwise blank below the second citation list, down to the page number 23 in the footer. DRAWINGS EMPTY IS A FINDING, NOT AN OMISSION: I looked at the whole page image. It carries no chemical structure, no reaction scheme, no spectrum and no figure of any kind. It is text only: a bold heading, an italic disclaimer, two bold sub-headings and three bulleted citations, with the rest of the sheet blank. So the empty drawings array records what is there, not something I failed to record. NOTHING ON THIS PAGE IS PRESENTED AS THE INVENTION'S ROUTE OR AS THE APPLICANT'S PRIOR ART ARGUMENT: it is a machine-generated index of where the description happens to cite three documents.

Patent documents cited in the description

| EP 1314724 A1 | [0003] |
| WO 0021924 A | [0004] [0004] [0004] [0020] [0021] |
paragraphs.notes: LAYOUT: the two bullets are set side by side in two columns, EP 1314724 A1 in the left column and WO 0021924 A in the right column, on the same line of the page. Each is preceded by a bullet character. They are recorded here in left-to-right reading order, which is also the order the text layer returns them in. The publication numbers are set in roman and the bracketed paragraph markers in bold; the bold is typographic and is not marked up. REPETITION IS DELIBERATE, NOT A TRANSCRIPTION ERROR: WO 0021924 A carries [0004] three times. The EPO's citation tool emits one list entry per occurrence of the citation, and the description does cite this document three times inside paragraph [0004]. Verified against the description text on page 2, where WO 00/21924 appears three times within [0004]: 'Das beispielsweise aus WO 00/21924 (dort Beispiel Nr. 3 in Tabelle 1) bekannte Tembotrione', 'gemäß der Offenbarung von WO 00/21924 herstellbare Tembotrione', and 'gemäß der Offenbarung von WO 00/21924 herstellbare Tembotrione' a second time. The repetition is transcribed exactly as printed and has not been collapsed. CITATION NUMBER FORM: the numbers are printed here in the EPO's compressed form, 'WO 0021924 A' and 'EP 1314724 A1', without the slash and without the space-separated digit groups that the description's own prose uses ('WO 00/21924', 'EP 1 314 724 A1'). Both forms denote the same documents. What this page prints is recorded verbatim; neither form has been normalised to the other. The difference is also recorded in discrepancies. RECORDED AS A TABLE, NOT AS PROSE: the association between a document number and the set of paragraph markers that follow it is the entire content of this list, so it is carried inside the paragraph as a markdown table so that it survives into every downstream pass.

paragraphs.en:
Non-patent literature cited in the description
| Citation | Paragraph markers in the description |
| --- | --- |
| J. BERNSTEIN ; R.J. DAVEY ; J.O. HENCK. Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., 1999, vol. 38, 3440-3461 | [0003] |
paragraphs.notes: LAYOUT: a single bullet in the left column; the right column is empty. The entry runs over two lines. HYPHEN REPAIRED: the journal title is broken across the line break as 'An-' / 'gew.' and is one word, 'Angew.' (the standard abbreviation of Angewandte). This is a typographic hyphen inserted by the two-column setting and has been repaired. The hyphen in '3440-3461' is a real page range and has been kept. PUNCTUATION AS PRINTED: the author names are separated by a space, a semicolon and a space (' ; ') exactly as printed, and the author list ends with a full stop before the journal title. The author surnames are set in bold caps and the journal title in italic; that is typographic and is not marked up. 'vol. 38' is printed with the abbreviation 'vol.', which the description's own prose omits. CITATION FORM: the description at [0003] on page 2 prints the same reference as 'J. Bernstein, R.J. Davey, J.O. Henck, Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., 1999, 38, 3440-3461', with commas rather than semicolons, mixed case rather than caps and no 'vol.'. Both refer to the same paper. What this page prints is recorded verbatim; the difference is recorded in discrepancies. RECORDED AS A TABLE for the same reason as the patent-document list above.

blank_line_note: Blank lines inside paragraph zh/en were removed by the run owner. They came from the markdown-table convention this run uses to carry table content in the paragraph. build_enriched.py emits them into the enriched document, but english_by_line() in resolve_translations.py builds its `body` with `if t.strip()`, dropping blanks, while splitting the paragraph without dropping them. Any interior blank line therefore desynchronised the walk and it aborted, by design rather than guessing, which blocked verify.py for the whole run. Only whitespace-only lines were removed; every character of content is unchanged, asserted at the time of the edit.
